confirmedFindings.title: Insecure JWT validation allows algorithm none or untrusted signing algorithms
confirmedFindings.body: JWT verification configuration explicitly includes "none" in the accepted algorithms list, allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge arbitrary tokens without a valid cryptographic signature.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Restrict allowed algorithms to explicit asymmetric algorithms (e.g. ["RS256"]) and strictly forbid "none".
